run_mutox_text_toxicity: run mutox_text to compute toxicity scores for input text in a specified language
run_mutox_text_batch: run mutox_text with a custom batch size to process multiple sentences efficiently
run_mutox_text_cuda: run mutox_text on a CUDA device to accelerate toxicity scoring with float16
run_mutox_text_piped: run mutox_text reading from stdin and writing tab-separated text and score to stdout
run_mutox_text_cpu: run mutox_text on CPU with float32 precision when no GPU is available
